items.title: An inverse limit of nonempty quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces is nonempty
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an inverse limit of nonempty quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces over a cofiltered category is nonempty (author lemma at source lines 2723-2729, label lemma-nonempty-limit). The proof (source lines 2731-2763) writes the limit as an intersection of closed subsets of the product cut out by the graphs of the transition maps, reduces by the finite intersection criterion to finitely many such subsets and constructs a compatible family using cofilteredness and equalization (proof lines 2731-2762). The finite intersection reduction and the construction of the compatible family are the substance. H3.
